answer: Cosignatures are collected in orchard, verified in comet, and wharf names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 22 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 316 aliases cost 65 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
